description: Look up one recall by its NHTSA campaign number (for example 20V314000, as printed on a US recall letter) and get the defect, risk, remedy, the number of vehicles potentially affected and every make, model and year it covers. For owners, journalists, lawyers and fleet managers. Source: NHTSA Recalls API. It does not say whether a specific vehicle has been repaired. (cost: 1 credit)

campaignNumber.description: string, required, NHTSA campaign number, e.g. 20V314000 or 20V-314

name: recall_campaign_details
